section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical analysis procedures used (SPSS v.24), handling of missing data (exclusion >20% missing, MCAR via Little's test, multiple imputation with 20 iterations), checks for entry errors/outliers, and analytic tests (t-tests, ANOVAs with Tukey HSD, bivariate correlations, stepwise linear regression with mean-centering). The section does not report sample characteristics (e.g., N, country, age, race/ethnicity percentages), measurement instruments (BAS/BAS-2), or specific correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
section_summary.evidence_source: All analyses were conducted using IBM SPSS v.24 for Windows. We initially assessed the data for missing values. Participants with more than 20% of their data missing were excluded from all analyses. Using Little's test (Little, 1988), the remaining missing data were determined to be missing completely at random (MCAR). We used pooled estimates from multiple imputation, using all relevant study variables in the imputation model and 20 iterations, to replace the remaining missing data.
